title: Exact Evaluation of sin(7*pi/12) via the Sine Sum Formula
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate \sin(7\pi/12) exactly by writing it as \sin(\pi/4 + \pi/3).

steps.title: Apply the Sine Addition Formula
steps.explanation: Note that pi/4 + pi/3 = 3*pi/12 + 4*pi/12 = 7*pi/12, and expand using sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B.
steps.why: Decomposing 7*pi/12 into special angles pi/4 and pi/3 allows exact radical evaluation.

steps.title: Substitute the Exact Values at pi/4 and pi/3
steps.explanation: Substitute sin(pi/4) = cos(pi/4) = sqrt(2)/2, cos(pi/3) = 1/2, and sin(pi/3) = sqrt(3)/2.
steps.why: These are the exact trigonometric values from 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 reference triangles.

steps.title: Combine Over the Common Denominator
steps.explanation: Multiply the radicals and combine the two fractions over the common denominator 4.
steps.why: sqrt(2)*sqrt(3) = sqrt(6) and both products have denominator 2*2 = 4.
